senses.gloss: able to continue without using up resources or causing serious harm

translations.th_TH: อย่างยั่งยืน

definition_translations.zh_TW: 可持續的，不破壞環境的

definition_translations.vi_VN: bền vững (không làm cạn kiệt tài nguyên)
